# BetterSanPedro

> Community-powered portal of the City of San Pedro, Laguna. BetterSanPedro is a volunteer-run, open-source civic portal. It is not the official website of the City of San Pedro.

- LGU: City of San Pedro, Laguna, Region IV-A (CALABARZON)
- Official LGU website: https://cityofsanpedrolaguna.gov.ph
- Portal: https://bettersanpedro.org

## Services
Requirements, steps, fees and processing times for 297 services, taken from the city's Citizen's Charter.

- [Certificates & Vital Records](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=certificates-vital-records): Birth, death, marriage certificates, and other vital records.
- [Business, Trade & Investment](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=business-trade-investment): Business permits, licenses, and trade registration services.
- [Social Services & Assistance](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=social-services-assistance): Welfare programs, senior citizen services, PWD benefits, and financial aid.
- [Health & Wellness](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=health-wellness): Vaccination programs, health certificates, and medical assistance.
- [Taxation & Payments](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=taxation-payments): Property tax, business tax, payments, and tax clearance.
- [Agriculture & Economic Development](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=agriculture-economic-development): Agricultural loans, crop insurance, fertilizer assistance, and training.
- [Infrastructure & Public Works](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=infrastructure-public-works): Construction permits, road maintenance requests, and public facilities.
- [Education & Scholarship](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=education-scholarship): Scholarship programs, student assistance, and educational grants.
- [Public Safety & Security](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=public-safety-security): Emergency services, disaster preparedness, and community safety programs.
- [Environment & Natural Resources](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=environment-natural-resources): Environmental permits, waste management, and conservation programs.
- [Executive & Legislative Services](https://bettersanpedro.org/services?category=executive-legislative-services): Requests, endorsements, clearances, and assistance from the Mayor, Vice Mayor, City Council, and other City Hall offices.

## Government
- City Mayor: Art Joseph Francis Mercado
- City Vice Mayor: Sheriliz B. Almoro
- 20th Sangguniang Panlungsod: 14 members
- [Elected officials](https://bettersanpedro.org/government/elected-officials)
- [Departments](https://bettersanpedro.org/government/departments): 42 offices
- [Barangays](https://bettersanpedro.org/government/barangays): 27 barangays
